title: ML Lifecycle
blurb: Put the machine-learning lifecycle in order.
source: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) exam guide · Domain 1

ladders.title: ML Lifecycle
ladders.prompt: Order the lifecycle from business goal to production monitoring.

steps.label: Business Goal Identification
steps.detail: Everything downstream inherits this. Without a business goal there is no way to say whether the model is any good.

steps.label: ML Problem Framing
steps.detail: Translate the goal into a learnable task: what is predicted, from what, and what counts as success.

steps.label: Data Collection
steps.detail: Assemble the raw material, and establish its provenance and permitted use before it is relied on.

steps.label: Data Preprocessing
steps.detail: Clean, join, de-duplicate and handle missing values, so the model learns signal rather than artefacts.

steps.label: Feature Engineering
steps.detail: Shape inputs into representations the algorithm can use. Often the largest single lever on accuracy.

steps.label: Model Training
steps.detail: Fit parameters on the training split. Cheap to repeat, so it comes after the expensive data work, not before.

steps.label: Hyperparameter Tuning
steps.detail: Search the settings the model cannot learn for itself, evaluated on validation data rather than test.

steps.label: Model Evaluation
steps.detail: Measure against held-out data and the business metric. This is the gate, not a formality.

steps.label: Model Deployment (Inference and Prediction)
steps.detail: Serve predictions for real requests, with the same preprocessing as training or the results will not match.

steps.label: Model Monitoring
steps.detail: Watch inputs, outputs and quality in production. This is where drift surfaces, and it never ends.
